children: Cardiff Lexington announced a letter of intent to acquire a multi-location musculoskeletal healthcare platform with up to $104 million consideration.
LOI for Proposed Transaction to buy a multi-state musculoskeletal platform, intended to expand orthopedics, spine and ancillary services.
Purchase Price up to $104 million: $30M cash at closing, $10M unsecured notes, preferred equity for sellers (35% post-close), and up to $12M earnout stock.
Earnouts: up to $4M common stock each if Target EBITDA > $15M (2027), > $18M (2028), and > $22M (2029).
LOI grants 30-month option to acquire certain Target facilities at appraised value and rights of first refusal on developing sites.
Transaction subject to 45-day due diligence, financing, quality-of-earnings review, definitive agreements and customary closing conditions.
